Class Implementor

java.lang.Object
info.kgeorgiy.ja.Gebesht.implementor.Implementor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Impler, JarImpler
public final class Implementor extends Object implements Impler, JarImpler
Generates implementations for interface tokens and can package generated implementation into a JAR file.

This class implements both:

  • Impler - source generation
  • JarImpler - source generation + compilation + JAR packaging
The current implementation corresponds to the easy version: only interfaces are supported.

      private void validateArgs(Class<?> token, Path root) throws ImplerException
